title: Disney Park
content: Omg so I saw in TikTok comments someone mentioning going back to a theme park that’s kinda like Disney often - does anyone else get this? It sent chills down my spine!! The moment I read this my mind flashed back to the numerous times I’ve been here in my dreams. At the beginning I think I’m in Disney, and then I’m lucid because I soon realise I’m not and everything isn’t how it should be - it feels very dystopian and I’m always lost and prevented by forces in the dream from doing anything I want.
